notes:
Top-level: hospital network + ambulatory EHR archive. Heavy PHI; cannot send raw notes to third-party without signed BAA and VPC/on-prem option.

Summary of need:
- RAG for clinical documentation search across outpatient notes, consult letters, radiology reports (~24M documents, growing).
- Primary pipeline: embeddings + reranking (dense retrieval + learned reranker). Need low p99 rerank latency for clinician UI.
- Targets: tail latency (reranker) < 250ms, end-to-end search (retrieve+rerank) < 350ms for 95% of queries. Throughput target: 150 QPS during morning rounds.
- Cost sensitivity: want clear cost-per-query modeling; target blended cost <$0.02/query at production scale.
- Indexing: initial POC 5M docs, full rollout ~24M docs; need incremental ingestion and delta embedding pipeline.

Security / deployment constraints:
- Must run within hospital VPC or customer-managed colo (on-prem). No PHI egress to public cloud control plane without encryption + legal approval.
- Mandatory SSO (SAML/Okta), per-token audit logging (who viewed which doc, which user id). 7-year retention on audit logs.
- KMS integration with customer HSM for key wrapping. Data residency: US-only.
- Require SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence; want security FAQ + penetration test report.

Model & architecture preferences:
- Prefer open/quantized models for reranker to run in Dedicated/Private (cost), but need fallback to Redwood hosted API when capacity constrained.
- Curious about Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and KV caching to meet latency/SLOs.
- Interested in embedding lifecycles: re-embedding cadence, incremental vs full reindex tradeoffs.
